items.title: Flood Susceptibility Mapping of Lalitpur District
items.imageCaption: Placeholder: flood map of Nepal. Replace with your susceptibility map.
items.summary: A GIS-based AHP/MCDA study combining elevation, slope, rainfall, land cover, NDVI, wetness, river distance and drainage density.
items.methods: QGIS, DEM terrain analysis, raster normalisation, AHP weighting, multi-criteria decision analysis, drainage analysis and map classification.
items.outcome: A classified flood-susceptibility surface that identifies the areas of Lalitpur District deserving closer attention in planning.

items.title: Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi Flood Event, August 2026
items.summary: A study of slope instability, debris flow, permafrost and cascading hazards behind the August 2026 flood.
items.methods: Literature synthesis, event chronology, geospatial context and critical evaluation of evidence.
items.outcome: A cause-focused analysis that separates established mechanisms from unresolved hypotheses.

items.title: River-Basin Hydrology in Nepal
items.summary: A comparison of discharge, glacier melt, monsoon rainfall and seasonal water availability across Nepalese basins, including the Gandaki.
items.methods: Comparative basin analysis using hydrological and climate data.
items.outcome: Insight into how mountain processes shape water supply in downstream river systems.
